gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Audiowide sets futuristic letters like tiles with wide grout lines, its line width never swelling or tapering. Yet it earns its keep big and short, while Noto Sans Meetei Mayek, a sans-serif, brings large lowercase eyes.
gen-flavors-gf-aldrich: Flavors is whimsical and commanding, with diagonals as hefty as its stems and a stubby, towering x-height. Aldrich handles the quieter work, its cupped rounds tracing a single thick thread.
gen-flavors-gf-blinker: Flavors is the whimsical, commanding one, with a towering x-height. Blinker handles the other half, keeping lines at a steady thickness with open apertures and lowercase that fills most of the height.
gen-flavors-gf-fresca: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors stacks diagonals as hefty as its stems under a towering x-height. Fresca keeps its strokes unthinned, with open apertures and short ascenders above big bowls, giving the display lines room.
gen-flavors-gf-geist: Flavors brings a whimsical, towering swagger up top. What stands out most is the gap between that commanding top line and Geist, a sans with a quiet level beat and solid word blocks.
gen-flavors-gf-hind-guntur: Flavors is whimsical and commanding, with a towering x-height. Hind Guntur does the steadier work, leaving wide gaps between curve ends and stems, its lowercase standing tall like stamped metal type.
gen-flavors-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru, a sans-serif, presses its lowercase tops close to ascender height with no calligraphic thinning. Hind Mysuru leaves the shouting to Flavors, whose whimsical, commanding x-height towers like a stubby pencil stroke.
gen-flavors-gf-hind-siliguri: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors lifts a towering x-height over diagonals as hefty as its stems. And Hind Siliguri hums along in a flat gray of constant line weight, with a gentle bump up to capitals.
gen-flavors-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara stays level in thickness, with spacious terminal gaps and big open-looking e and a. Hind Vadodara leaves the commanding moments to Flavors, whose towering x-height does the whimsical shouting.
gen-flavors-gf-huninn: Huninn reads modern and sturdy, with s terminals held away from the body and lowercase rising close to cap height. Size Huninn modestly beside Flavors, and its fat crossbars will hold.
